runs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: orthographic 3D model albedo texture-source painting.
Output one 1024 x 1024 PNG with genuine transparent background, at the guide's original size, unresized.
Input roles: Image 1 is the exact grey orthographic model guide and EDIT TARGET. Image 2 (design_reference.png) is the approved material and colour reference ONLY, not a shape or camera reference. Image 3 (concept_crop.png) is the original concept, secondary appearance reference.
Edit only the surface colour of Image 1. Keep its EXACT silhouette, alpha boundary, position, scale, camera, every shape edge, rib, opening, and detail. Every opaque guide pixel must remain part of the object at the same position; every transparent guide pixel must remain transparent. Do not redesign, rotate, zoom, widen, recenter, crop, smooth away the geometry, or add protrusions. The guide occupies x=331 through 692, y=66 through 957 on the 1024 square canvas. Keep those exact pixel bounds, the very fine tip at x=512,y=66, and the broad base on y=957.
Paint the guide surfaces using the reference materials: black-violet resin and chitin with organic surface grain; saturated glowing orange slit windows confined to existing inset/slit shapes; ivory bone on the existing thorns and tip. The material is glossy wet resin in identity, but this image must be an ALBEDO texture source, so remove rendered gloss lighting. Preserve the dark violet/plum and ivory/orange colour relationships.
LIGHTING: perfectly even flat shadowless frontal illumination. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion or darkening at creases, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no white reflective streaks, no rim light, no lighting gradient. Orange glowing parts are painted at their glowing colour without bloom, halos, or any light cast onto surrounding resin.
Transparent alpha outside the guide object, no black backdrop, no grey backdrop, no painted checkerboard, no floor, no background, no labels, no text. Only the single painted guide.
VIEW: LEFT. Paint guide_left.png exactly as shown, retaining the intersecting ribs and paired long openings in the middle and the small diamond inset near the base. Use only the left guide for geometry.
